basic_details.job_title: UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 25 Executive Engineer, Assistant Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Directorate of Urban Development, Uttarakhand (UDD Uttarakhand) Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released for 5 different engineering posts with a total of 25 vacancies. The recruitment includes posts such as Executive Engineer, Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Junior Engineer (Civil), Junior Engineer (Mechanical) and Junior Engineer (Electrical).

and disciplinary or vigilance clearance. Selected candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the competent authority of their parent department before joining on deputation.
how_to_apply: Eligible and willing officers or employees of Central Government, State Government departments, corporations, or public undertakings should prepare their application with complete bio-data and details of their service record.

content_sections.heading: UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Directorate of Urban Development, Uttarakhand (UDD Uttarakhand) has released the UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026 notification for filling 5 different engineering posts on a deputation basis. A total of 25 vacancies have been announced, including 11 vacancies for Junior Engineer (Electrical), 6 vacancies for Junior Engineer (Civil), 5 vacancies for Executive Engineer, 2 vacancies for Junior Engineer (Mechanical), and 1 vacancy for Assistant Engineer (Electrical). The applications must be submitted through the proper/registered channel or in person on or before 05 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. content_sections.heading: UDD Uttarakhand Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: As per the vacancy table in the notification: *The eligibility table elsewhere in the notification lists Junior Engineer (Civil) at pay band 9300-34800 / Grade Pay 4600. Candidates should verify the exact pay details on the official website before applying.

content_sections.heading: UDD Uttarakhand Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is restricted to serving government-sector employees. Common conditions across posts: The applicant must currently be a regular or permanent employee of a Central Government, State Government department, corporation, or public sector undertaking, already holding a post in the same grade pay as the post applied for. The applicant must have experience working in an engineering post and completed 3 years of continuous, satisfactory service in that department. There must be no pending departmental disciplinary or vigilance inquiry against the applicant. Employees of local bodies (स्थानीय निकाय) are not eligible and their applications will not be accepted under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: UDD Uttarakhand Qualification
content_sections.text: The notification also lists eligibility for Assistant Engineer (Civil) and Assistant Engineer (Mechanical) qualification criteria in its detailed eligibility table, though these two posts do not appear as separate vacancies in the main vacancy table for this cycle.

rows.qualification_as_per_notification: Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering from a Central/State Government-recognised institution, OR passed Associate Membership (Sections A & B) of the Institution of Engineers (India) in Civil Engineering
Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution, OR AMIE (Sections A & B) in Electrical Engineering
Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution, OR AMIE (Sections A & B) in Civil Engineering
Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering from a recognised institution, OR AMIE (Sections A & B) in Mechanical Engineering
Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution, OR AMIE (Sections A & B) in Electrical Engineering

content_sections.heading: UDD Uttarakhand Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe a written examination or interview. The process described is: Scrutiny of applications and bio-data submitted through the employer's proper or registered channel, or in person. Verification of eligibility, qualification, experience, and disciplinary or vigilance clearance. Selected candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the competent authority of their parent department before joining on deputation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UDD Uttarakhand Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible and willing officers or employees of Central Government, State Government departments, corporations, or public undertakings should prepare their application with complete bio-data and details of their service record. The application must be forwarded through the proper or registered channel, that is, via the applicant's appointing authority or competent authority, or submitted in person. Applications must reach the Directorate by 5:00 PM on 5 October 2026. Applications received after this deadline will be automatically treated as rejected. Detailed educational qualification and eligibility criteria are available on the departmental website: www.udd.uk.gov.in

content_sections.heading: Important Notes
content_sections.text: Applications from employees currently working in local bodies will not be accepted under any circumstances. Selected candidates must produce a departmental NOC before being released on deputation. Some portions of the scanned notification, particularly parts of the detailed eligibility table for Assistant Engineer Civil and Mechanical, are not fully legible. Candidates should cross-check the full notice on the official website before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is UDD Uttarakhand Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notice from the Directorate of Urban Development, Uttarakhand, inviting applications to fill 25 engineering posts (Executive Engineer, Assistant Engineer, Junior Engineer) on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 25 posts across Executive Engineer, Assistant Engineer (Electrical), and Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) categories.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Only regular or permanent employees of Central Government, State Government departments, corporations, or public sector undertakings who hold the matching grade pay, have relevant engineering experience, and have completed 3 years of continuous satisfactory service. Local body employees are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
Q5. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A diploma or B.Tech/B.E. in the relevant engineering discipline (Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical) from a recognised institution, or the equivalent AMIE qualification, in addition to already holding a matching government engineering post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: By submitting a complete application with bio-data through the proper or registered channel via your employer's appointing authority, or in person, by the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The notification describes document and eligibility scrutiny followed by a mandatory NOC from the parent department before joining. No written exam or interview is mentioned.
